Pralhad Joshi officially assumed charge as the Union Minister of Education. The Indian Embassy in Ukraine is monitoring the situation after a cargo vessel carrying four Indian seafarers was struck at the Black Sea port of Odessa; two seafarers have been confirmed safe, while information on the other two is awaited. Defence Minister Rajnath Singh, on Kargil Vijay Diwas, stated that India would only engage in talks with Pakistan regarding Pakistan-occupied Kashmir (PoK), which he affirmed as an illegally occupied part of India. Prime Minister Narendra Modi, during his 'Mann Ki Baat' radio broadcast, highlighted India's growing role as a trusted global defense partner and its continuous efforts to strengthen defense capabilities. Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha, Rahul Gandhi, has written to Union Home Minister Amit Shah, seeking accountability for the "barbaric assault on students" during peaceful protests in Delhi on July 20, 2026, and questioning if the use of "lethal force" was authorized. Delhi Police are expected to withdraw FIRs filed in connection with the 36-day Jantar Mantar protest led by the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP), following the agitation's conclusion. Sarnath has been officially recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, 28 years after being placed on the tentative list. The DRDO successfully conducted the maiden flight test of the Kusha Long-Range Surface-to-Air Missile (LR-SAM) system. Researchers from the Indian Institute of Science (IISc) in Bengaluru have identified potential applications of ultrasound stimulation technology in treating oral cancer, finding that Stage IV oral cancer cells are selectively vulnerable to this low-frequency ultrasound (LFU) mechanostimulation.

## SECTION 14 — Telangana State Updates
Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy has advocated for reducing the minimum age to contest Assembly and Parliament elections from 25 to 21 years, noting that individuals aged 21 can already become IAS officers or elected representatives in local bodies. He plans to move a resolution in the Telangana Legislative Assembly in August to address this issue in Parliament. Chief Minister Revanth Reddy also called for stringent laws and comprehensive reforms in India's education and examination frameworks to prevent paper leaks, urging a structured nationwide debate in Parliament to protect students' interests. Two 17-year-old intermediate students were killed in Hyderabad when a lorry rammed into their scooter as they were on their way to play cricket. A third teenager sustained minor injuries. A major fire erupted at the foothills of the Sri Parvathi Jadala Ramalingeswara Swamy Temple in Chervugattu, Nalgonda district, destroying 17 shops, 15 pushcarts, and damaging Gram Panchayat records, with an estimated loss of ₹2.5 crore. Telangana food safety officials conducted raids on a food unit, seizing 110 kg of 'sev' and 40 litres of cooking oil due to multiple violations.

## SECTION 18 — Deep Analysis of Most Important Breaking News
**What Happened:** Defence Minister Rajnath Singh stated that India would only engage in talks with Pakistan regarding Pakistan-occupied Kashmir (PoK), asserting that PoK is an illegally occupied part of India. This statement was made on Kargil Vijay Diwas, commemorating India's victory in the 1999 Kargil War.
**Root Causes:** The historical dispute over Kashmir, particularly the status of Pakistan-occupied Kashmir, has been a central point of contention between India and Pakistan since partition in 1947. India maintains that the entire erstwhile princely state of Jammu and Kashmir, including PoK, is an integral part of its territory.
**Historical Background:** The Kargil War in 1999 was a military conflict between India and Pakistan that took place in the Kargil district of Jammu and Kashmir and along the Line of Control (LoC). The conflict arose after Pakistani forces infiltrated into Indian-controlled positions. India launched "Operation Vijay" to reclaim these territories. The current statement builds upon India's long-held position on Kashmir.
**Key Actors:** Key actors include Defence Minister Rajnath Singh, representing the Indian government's official stance, and the broader Indian political and military leadership. Pakistan is the other primary actor in this long-standing territorial dispute.
**Strategic Importance:** This statement reiterates India's firm position on PoK, reinforcing its territorial claims and potentially influencing future diplomatic engagements between India and Pakistan. It sends a clear message regarding India's non-negotiable stance on its sovereignty.
**Possible Long-Term Consequences:** The assertion may further entrench positions on both sides, potentially complicating future bilateral dialogue. It could also influence regional power dynamics and the international community's perception of the Kashmir dispute, particularly regarding the viability of comprehensive peace talks.

*   2005: STS-114, the first Space Shuttle "Return to Flight" mission after the Columbia disaster, launches.
